h1: Engineering intelligent systems. Building new possibilities.
sub: Engineer, developer and innovator. I design programming languages, AI-agent platforms and developer tools, and carry them from specification to working software.
w_l: Fourteen projects built from scratch, each labelled with what is built and what is still in progress.
c_l: Every compiler stage has an explicit interface and a stated status.
c_1: A normative specification decides semantics. Where it is silent or contradictory, the implementation does not invent behavior.
c_2: Generation one: a minimal Rust core. Two: a complete Rust platform. Three: an independently qualified, self-hosted Omni compiler.
c_3: Challenge: keeping grammar, semantics, code and tests consistent as the language grows.
